Alex —

Thanks, Wed 10:00am PT confirmed. Joining from Redwood: Jordan (solutions lead) and David (customer reliability).

Below is a concise, plain-language benchmark and the assumptions behind the $/1M token numbers in the attached PDF. I kept it short for your engineering lead.

Assumptions common to all comparisons:
- Mix: 50% chat (context + response), 50% generation (single-shot prompts)
- Avg tokens per request: chat 350 tokens, generation 60 tokens
- 120M tokens/month baseline (we include scaled numbers in the worksheet)
- Dedicated config uses 8xA100-equivalent with quantization/AMP where applicable; hosted uses best available managed tiers.

Benchmark ($ per 1M tokens, effective unit cost inclusive of infra and ops):
- Redwood Hosted (optimized kernels + batching + prefix cache): $1,800 / 1M tokens
- Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity + intelligent batching, expected at your volumes): $1,200 / 1M tokens (estimate with a 12-month commit and autoscale buffer)
- OpenAI (gpt-4o-style hosted; managed): $2,400 / 1M tokens (public tier estimate for chat-heavy workloads)
- Anthropic (Claude-class hosted): $2,200 / 1M tokens
- Managed open-model hosts (unoptimized quantized on-cloud providers): $1,600–$2,800 / 1M tokens (wide variance depending on optimization & region)
- Self-hosted open models (your infra + ops): $900–$1,500 / 1M tokens, but assumes you manage infra, SRE, and model telemetry (hidden org cost)

Key reasons for Redwood delta vs others (what matters for procurement/engineering):
- vs OpenAI/Anthropic hosted: Redwood Dedicated lowers unit cost by allowing reserved GPU pools, smarter batching and caching (savings on throughput and repeated prefixes) while providing equivalent latency SLAs and private deployment options. The gap widens as token volume grows.
- vs managed open-model hosts: Redwood provides better throughput determinism and observability (tracing, token-level cost breakdowns) that reduces tail latency and cost surprises.
- vs self-hosted: Self-hosting can be cheaper per-token if you have mature infra, but you absorb operational risk, engineering headcount, and longer time-to-value. Redwood offsets that with turnkey Private deployments and SLOs.

Starter pricing model notes (see attached spreadsheet):
- For 120M/mo baseline: we modeled Dedicated with a 12-month commit and 2x burst capacity. Effective blended unit cost: ~$1,200 / 1M tokens.
- Growth to 400M/mo: unit cost falls toward $950–$1,050 / 1M as you leverage more reserved capacity and larger batching windows.
- Introduction offer: 25% credit on first 3 months of usage for proof-of-concept (applies to Hosted or Dedicated during onboarding).

Attached are the worksheets and the short benchmarking PDF. We'll walk through the spreadsheet Wed. If procurement needs SOC2 evidence/SLA language before the call, Jordan can share our standard artifacts — Jordan, can you post the SOC2 link and SLA note in reply?

Thanks,
Marissa
